definition: Total money received from orders. Computed as SUM(order_items.subtotal) or SUM(orders.total_amount) for delivered/completed orders.
sql_hint: SUM(oi.subtotal) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

definition: Gross Merchandise Value — total value of all orders placed, regardless of status. Use SUM(orders.total_amount).
Average Order Value — average total_amount per order. Computed as AVG(orders.total_amount).
Percentage of orders that were successfully delivered vs all orders placed.
sql_hint: COUNT(CASE WHEN status='delivered' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM orders

definition: Customers who placed an order more than 90 days ago and have not ordered since.
sql_hint: Customers where MAX(orders.created_at) < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'

definition: A customer who has placed more than one order.
sql_hint: customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

definition: Product with the highest total revenue or units sold. Join order_items to products and aggregate.
sql_hint: SUM(oi.subtotal) as revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

definition: Month-over-Month — comparing a metric from the current month to the previous month.
sql_hint: Use DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) to group by month

definition: Quarter-over-Quarter — comparing a metric from the current quarter to the previous quarter.
sql_hint: Use DATE_TRUNC('quarter', created_at) to group by quarter

definition: Year-over-Year — comparing a metric from the current year to the previous year.
sql_hint: Use EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) to group by year
